Our data engineering team has left a rough draft of an automation capability in the `draft_submissions/ledger-normalizer-DRAFT/` folder. The notes in there describe what it should do: read raw brokerage trade CSV files and convert them to normalized ledger JSON. The draft is a mess — wrong structure, wrong format, stuff that shouldn't be there.

I need you to turn this into a properly packaged, validated skill in our shared library at `codex_skills/`. The skill should be named `ledger-normalizer`.

The final skill must:
- Be properly initialized using the standard tooling available in `scripts/`
- Include a `references/` folder with a file explaining the data-transformation logic (timestamp conversion, field mapping, validation rules) extracted from the draft notes
- Have a user-facing interface configured with a clean display name ('Ledger Normalizer') and a short description ('Normalize brokerage trade CSV exports into canonical ledger JSON')
- Pass the standard validation check

Do not touch the `email-triage-DRAFT` folder. Only fix the ledger normalizer.
